findings.remediation: Find and remove it. Text shaped like an instruction - a fake system prompt, a demand to ignore earlier instructions, a fabricated end-of-output marker - is either an attempt to steer models reading your site, or user-generated content nobody reviewed. Either way it is on your domain and it is what an engine quotes when it cites you.
findings.title: A page contains text addressed to an AI system

findings.remediation: Add /llms.txt: one H1 title, a blockquote summary, then H2 sections of markdown links to the pages worth reading. It is a convention rather than a standard, and no engine is known to require it - but it costs an afternoon and it states your own priorities in your own words.
